title: Commutative-monoid sheafification on opens with trivial covers
statement:
Let $X$ be a topological space. Work in a common universe containing the opens of $X$ and all coefficient sets, so that its open site is small [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $Q$ be a presheaf of commutative monoids on this site: its restriction maps preserve addition and zero. A monoid sheaf is such a presheaf whose underlying set presheaf is a sheaf. Let $\eta:Q\to Q^\#$ be its monoid sheafification, in the universal-property sense of [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Then the underlying set presheaf of $Q^\#$, with the same unit $\eta$, is a set-valued sheafification of the underlying set presheaf of $Q$.
For every open $W$, each element of $Q^\#(W)$ lifts to $Q$ on an open cover of $W$, and two elements of $Q(W)$ with the same image under $\eta_W$ agree on an open cover of $W$.
Let $\mathcal B$ be any collection of nonempty opens such that every open cover of each $U\in\mathcal B$ has $U$ as a member. For every $U\in\mathcal B$, the component $\eta_U:Q(U)\to Q^\#(U)$ is a monoid isomorphism. These component isomorphisms and their inverses commute with restriction along all inclusions $V\subseteq U$ with $U,V\in\mathcal B$; thus the resulting identifications preserve zero, addition, and all such restrictions.

source.place: VIII Remark 3.1.4(iii), printed pp.98--99, sheafification on trivially covered affine opens; general monoid-valued formulation of old proof steps 3--5 and the naturality in step 7. proof.text: Use Mathlib AddCommMonCat.FilteredColimits.colimitCoconeIsColimit to supply colimits over the filtered category of covering sieves. The concrete sheafification instance of Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.LeftExact then supplies standard additive-commutative-monoid sheafification in the common universe. This avoids the multiplicative-only existential interface of lem-trf-commutative-monoid-sheafification.

source.place: Tag 00YR (section-sheaves-algebraic-structures), assertions (alpha), (gamma), (epsilon) for commutative monoids, and Proposition 00WH (proposition-sheafification-adjoint): uniqueness of a sheafification up to unique isomorphism compatible with the units.

proof.text: Use the standard sheafification universal property and the given bijectivity hη to construct maps in both directions. sheafify_hom_ext and injectivity of hη show that they are inverse. Apply sheafifyComposeIso for forget AddCommMonCat and sheafComposeIso_hom_fac to obtain an isomorphism from standard set sheafification to the given underlying presheaf, compatible with the unit. The underlying presheaf is a sheaf by Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget. Precompose with this comparison and use sheafifyLift and sheafify_hom_ext to prove existence and uniqueness of set-valued factorizations.

source.place: Tag 00YR (section-sheaves-algebraic-structures), assertions (alpha), (gamma), (epsilon) for commutative monoids, and Proposition 00WH (proposition-sheafification-adjoint): uniqueness of a sheafification up to unique isomorphism compatible with the units.

proof.text: Mathlib Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective and Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective hold for the standard unit and are stable under composition with an isomorphism. Transport them using the monoid comparison. For a covering sieve S on W, take the family indexed by pairs (V, f) where f : V → W lies in S. Every domain lies in W, and the covering condition says every point of W lies in some domain, so their supremum equals W. Apply this construction to imageSieve for local lifts and equalizerSieve for local equality. The construction also permits the empty family on the empty open.

source.place: Tag 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification) and Tag 00WB (theorem-plus), parts (2) and (4); equality clause as stated in lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local.

proof.text: For U in B, choose a member V i = U from each local lifting or equality cover using hB. The covering arrow is an isomorphism by homOfLE_isIso_of_eq. The injectivity of restriction proves equality of two sections whose images agree. For surjectivity, pull a local representative back by the inverse restriction in Q, and use naturality and injectivity of restriction in Qsharp to show that its image is the desired section.

source.place: VIII Remark 3.1.4(iii), printed pp.98--99: every open covering of an affine fan open contains that open; the same cover argument applies to the stated collection.

proof.text: The forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, so ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective turns each unit component on B into an isomorphism. Its forward map is the given component by construction. Naturality proves compatibility with restriction for the forward maps; cancel the component isomorphisms to obtain compatibility for the inverse maps.

source.place: VIII Remark 3.1.4(iii), printed pp.98--99, functoriality of the affine-open description; explicit naturality calculation.
